project.name: Robot arm visual MVP task-preserving edit demo
project.description: Local seed project for a desktop-openable robot arm visual MVP before solver-backed CAD workers are added.

active_task.description: Lift and place a 50 lb payload at 0.65 m reach with advisory safety-factor tracking.
assumptions: Static payload approximation until FEA, actuator torque, and motion workers are wired.

assemblies.name: Six-part robot arm with wrist gripper visual MVP

parts.name: Base pedestal plate
parts.purpose: Bolts the robot arm to the bench and reacts overturning torque from the shoulder and payload.

manufacturing_options.description: CNC cut or waterjet plate with drilled mounting pattern.
risk_notes: Base is intentionally heavy for the visual MVP; anchor pull-out is review-required.

manufacturing_options.description: Laser cut plate with tapped inserts or welded standoffs.
risk_notes: Flatness and anchor pattern need supplier review.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: Demo estimate for base reaction load. It is not FEA; anchor bolts, bench stiffness, and tip-over checks require engineering review.

parts.name: Shoulder yoke joint
parts.purpose: Holds the shoulder bearing and transfers the first arm link load into the base.

manufacturing_options.description: CNC machined yoke with bearing bore left undersized for finishing.
risk_notes: Bearing bore alignment and shoulder bolt preload are review-required.

manufacturing_options.description: Printed yoke for packaging and fit checks only.
risk_notes: Printed yoke is not trusted for the 50 lb lift task without re-rating.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: Seeded shoulder reaction estimate for demo triage only. Bearing life, motor torque, fatigue, and deflection are review-required.

parts.name: Upper arm link
parts.purpose: Spans from the shoulder to elbow and is the main bending member for the 0.65 m reach task.

manufacturing_options.description: Pocketed aluminum link with ribs left visible for inspection.
risk_notes: Rib depth and pin hole edge distance are demo estimates and need CAD review.
Useful for reach mockup; payload capability is review-required.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: Demo estimate for bending under the preserved lift role. This is not FEA; deflection at reach and fatigue life need solver-backed review.

parts.name: Elbow joint hub
parts.purpose: Connects upper arm and forearm links while carrying the wrist and gripper moment.

manufacturing_options.description: CNC hub with bearing pocket and serviceable cover.
risk_notes: Bearing fit, set-screw retention, and cover clearance require review.

manufacturing_options.description: Printed hub for motion envelope mockup.
risk_notes: Printed hub should be labeled fit-check only for this lift task.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: Seeded elbow hub capacity for the visual review only. Bearing contact pressure and dynamic shock are not solved.

parts.name: Forearm link
parts.purpose: Carries the wrist plate and tool head to the target object while keeping harness routing accessible.

manufacturing_options.description: Machined link with a shallow cable channel.
risk_notes: Cable-channel fillets and fastener edge distance need CAD review.

manufacturing_options.description: SLS composite forearm for fit and routing evaluation.
risk_notes: Composite forearm requires print orientation and payload review.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: Demo estimate for wrist-side bending. Not a solver result; real FEA will replace it with stress and deflection maps.

parts.name: Wrist tool plate
parts.purpose: Adapts the forearm to the gripper and gives the tool harness a controlled service loop.

manufacturing_options.description: CNC or waterjet adapter plate with counterbored holes.
risk_notes: Bolt pattern is a demo placeholder and needs interface review.
Standoff stiffness and gripper fit need review.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: Seeded tool plate estimate for the 50 lb lift role. Gripper bolt shear and wrist torque remain review-required.

parts.name: Parallel gripper jaw link
parts.purpose: Closes on the workpiece at the wrist so the arm demo still has a selectable end-effector load path.

manufacturing_options.description: 2.5D CNC machined gripper jaw link with deburred edges.
risk_notes: Best current demo fit for the preserved 50 lb lift task, but real jaw contact checks are missing.

manufacturing_options.description: Prototype print for fit checks only unless re-rated.
risk_notes: Layer direction can make payload rating much lower.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: Seeded quick-check limit for the demo gripper jaw. This is not FEA and needs review before the 50 lb lift task is trusted.

parts.name: Controller PCB placeholder
parts.purpose: Represents the motor, encoder, and tool IO board so electrical constraints stay visible in the mechanical demo.

manufacturing_options.description: 4-layer PCB fabrication placeholder with connector keepouts.
risk_notes: Board support, connector strain relief, and thermal dissipation are review-required.

demo_design_criteria.load_capacity_note: The PCB is not a load-bearing part in this seed assembly. Board support, connector loads, and heat dissipation need review.

materials.name: Aluminum 6061-T6
notes: Common robot arm prototype material. Values are generic seeds, not supplier-certified data.

materials.name: Carbon-fiber reinforced nylon
notes: Layer direction and print settings dominate real strength. Use as demo material guidance only.

materials.name: Low-carbon steel
notes: Strong and stiff but heavier; payload and motor torque need review after substitution.

materials.name: Generic PLA printed polymer
notes: Fit-check material only for load-bearing arm parts in this demo.

materials.name: Generic PETG printed polymer
notes: Useful for covers and cable guides, not trusted for the 50 lb arm task without review.

materials.name: Generic FR-4 PCB laminate
notes: PCB values are not load ratings; board mounting and connectors need review.

result_summary.message: Demo robot arm assembly metadata is normalized into selectable parts.
Demo exploded transforms are available for visual interaction.
Quick heuristic is labeling review areas only; no worker-supplied payload rating is available.
FEA is not running in this MVP. Demo criteria will be replaced by solver artifacts later.
Wiring route check is queued behind CAD geometry extraction.
Supplier and fabrication estimates are ready for a low-cost worker handoff.

reports.title: Visual MVP readiness advisory
reports.summary: Robot arm demo is visually inspectable with seeded material guidance, clickable parts, and no claim of real FEA.
manufacturing_impacts: Arm links are shown with plausible CNC and additive options, but supplier quotes are not connected.
wiring_impacts: Harness routes are visible and linked to selected parts, but motion sweep clearance is not computed.
risks: Demo load limits are seeded estimates, not certified payload ratings.
Future FEA and actuator torque checks must replace visual triage before engineering release.
unknowns: Real CAD geometry, actuator torque curves, fastener preload, fatigue life, heat dissipation, and supplier pricing.
recommendations: Use this MVP for visual review and UX feedback.
Next work order should attach real geometry import and FEA artifact plumbing.
assumptions: Static lift task is preserved at 50 lb for demonstration only.
